title.narrative: Apoyo al Sector Transporte de Hait - V
Support for Haiti's Transport Sector V

description.narrative: El objetivo general del proyecto es aumentar la competitividad, conectividad y accesibilidad territorial de Hait reduciendo los costos de transporte y prestando servicios de transporte ms seguros, lo que fomentar la integracin regional e internacional del pas. Entre los objetivos especficos se encuentran la rehabilitacin del tramo de la Ruta Nacional 1 (RN-1) ubicado entre Camp Coq y Vaudreuil, y mltiples obras de rehabilitacin, mejora o mantenimiento de las redes viales primaria y secundaria de Hait.

The overall objective of the project is to increase the competitiveness, connectivity, and territory accessibility in Haiti by reducing transportation costs and providing safer transport services, thus promoting the countrys regional and international integration. Specific objectives include the rehabilitation of a road segment on Route Nationale 1 (RN-1) between Camp Coq and Vaudreuil and multiple works of rehabilitation, improvement andor maintenance in Haitis primary and secondary road networks.
